newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA to double Curacao refinery gasoline in 6 yrs.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA to double Curacao refinery gasoline in 6 yrs.

text.p: Venezuela's state-owned Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) plans to double gasoline and naphtha output from its Curacao refinery to 120,000 barrels per day over the next six years through a $360 million investment program, a top company official said.
"With this investment the capacity will double to reach 120,000 bpd," PDVSA vice-President Claus Graf told reporters at a breakfast meeting.
Graf said the increased gasoline and naphtha output would come at the expense of residual fuels such as bunker fuels and heating oil.
Graf said the Curacao refinery currently has an overall refining capacity of 160,000 bpd of which just 60,000 bpd is gasoline production.
The additional gasoline output will be used to meet growing demand in the Caribbean, Graf added.
